_doc: Curated card lore notes for scripts/build_card_enrichment.py (Bot cycle 33, Phase 8, #100). Key = exact card name. relation: depicts | references | echoes (echoes = mechanics mirror a cited moment; guidance). Every note cites official (wizards.com) pages; every double-quoted passage must be verbatim in a cited cached page (checked by build_card_enrichment.py --check). flag: optional ⚠️ / 🚫.

Godsend.text: Heliod "reforged the sword into the spear Godsend"; Elspeth later "stabbed Xenagos with Godsend, destroying him once and for all"

Blackblade Reforged.text: the weapon the *Dominaria* (2018) heroes seek: "So this Blackblade would kill Belzenlok."

The Mightstone and Weakstone.text: the two halves of the stone the brothers split; *The Brothers' War* episode 5 ends with "Mightstone and Weakstone, reunited at last, within the surviving brother."

Helvault.text: Avacyn's prison: Griselbrand would "trap her in the Helvault", and "When the Helvault shattered, Avacyn emerged at her full strength."

The Immortal Sun.text: the Sun Empire's lost relic: "Emperor Apatzec Intli was gifted the Immortal Sun in a fateful encounter, and vowed to conquer the merfolk and raze the jungle."
